Multi-agent unit rate: total ÷ trucks ÷ trips (多车多趟→一车一趟)

questions.title: 比较效率
questions.q: 小明 6 小时完成了 2160 个零件，李师傅 8 小时完成了 2560 个零件。谁的工作效率更高？高出多少？

options.A: 李师傅更高，每小时多 40 个
options.B: 小明更高，每小时多 40 个
options.D: 小明更高，每小时多 640 个

wrong.A: 算反了。小明 360 个/小时，李师傅 320 个/小时，是小明更高。
wrong.D: 640 是两人完成量的差（2560−2160），不是每小时效率的差。应先各自算出每小时再比较：360−320=40。

questions.mistakes: 用总工作量差代替效率差；谁快搞反。

questions.title: Find the work (r×t=W)
questions.q: Lucas packs 185 cartons per hour. How many cartons does he pack in 12 hours?

wrong.A: You added 185 + 12. Multiply rate by time: 185 × 12 = 2220.
wrong.C: You subtracted 185 − 12. Work is rate times time.
wrong.D: 1850 is only 185 × 10. He worked 12 hours, so add two more hours: 1850 + 370 = 2220.

questions.mistakes: Adding or subtracting instead of multiplying; multiplying by 10 only.

questions.title: 多车多趟求一车一趟
questions.q: 3 辆卡车一共运了 2 趟，共运走 3750 箱水果。照这样算，1 辆卡车运 1 趟可以运多少箱？

wrong.A: 1250 只除了卡车数（3750÷3），还要再除趟数 2。
wrong.B: 1875 只除了趟数（3750÷2），还要再除卡车数 3。
wrong.D: 7500 是乘了 2，不是除。要把总箱数除以卡车数和趟数。

wrong.A: You may have done 960 ÷ 16 = 60, then 60 − 4 = 56, then something else. Do (16−4) first, then divide 960 by 12.
wrong.C: 60 is 960 ÷ 16. You skipped the (16−4) step. Use 960 ÷ 12 = 80, then 80 × 25 = 2000.

questions.title: 结合律简便运算
questions.q: 用简便方法计算 125 × 48 × 8。正确结果是哪一个？

questions.title: Plan vs actual
questions.q: A bakery planned to bake 5400 loaves in 9 days (same number each day). They finished all 5400 loaves in only 6 days. How many more loaves per day did they bake than planned?
questions.explanation: Planned rate = 5400 ÷ 9 = 600 loaves per day. Actual rate = 5400 ÷ 6 = 900 loaves per day. Difference = 900 − 600 = 300 more loaves per day.

wrong.B: 900 is the actual daily amount, not how many more than the plan. Subtract: 900 − 600 = 300.
wrong.C: 600 is the planned daily amount. The question asks how many more than planned: 900 − 600 = 300.
wrong.D: You may have halved 300 or used (9−6). Find both daily rates first, then subtract.

questions.mistakes: Reporting plan or actual rate instead of the difference; using day difference without rates.
